title: Welcome to the City

pre.en: What does Chen really want Wei to do before he arrives?
pre.zh: Chen 其实希望小魏来之前做什么？
options: Learn the metro map by heart.

intro: 一段对话：小魏找到了新工作，下个月要搬来 Chen 所在的城市，Chen 把自己两个月来的经验一条条告诉他。读的时候留意现在完成时：说到现在为止有没有过某种经历、有过几次，用 have done，常带 ever、never 或次数；说具体什么时候发生的事，仍用一般过去时。最后几句话别错过。

sentences.en: Chen, guess what?
sentences.zh: 小陈，你猜怎么着？
sentences.speaker: Wei

sentences.en: I got the job!
sentences.zh: 我拿到那份工作了！

sentences.en: I'm moving to your city next month.
sentences.zh: 下个月我就搬去你那个城市了。

sentences.en: No way!
sentences.zh: 真的假的！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Congratulations!
sentences.zh: 恭喜恭喜！

sentences.en: Well, I moved here two months ago, so I'm basically an expert.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我两个月前搬过来的，差不多算半个专家了。

sentences.en: Go on, ask me.
sentences.zh: 来吧，尽管问。

sentences.en: OK, expert.
sentences.zh: 好嘞，专家。
sentences.speaker: Wei

sentences.en: What's the best way to get around?
sentences.zh: 在那儿出门，怎么走最方便？

sentences.en: The metro, definitely.
sentences.zh: 坐地铁，肯定的。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I know the map by heart now.
sentences.zh: 线路图我现在都背下来了。

sentences.en: Back home I used to take taxis everywhere, but I've never taken one here.
sentences.zh: 在老家我去哪儿都打车，可在这儿一次都没打过。

sentences.en: They cost a fortune.
sentences.zh: 贵得要命。

sentences.en: Have you ever got lost?
sentences.zh: 你迷过路没有？
sentences.speaker: Wei

sentences.en: Oh, loads of times.
sentences.zh: 哎，太多次了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I've got lost in the main station three times.
sentences.zh: 光在总站里我就迷过三回。

sentences.en: Once it took me forty minutes to find my way out.
sentences.zh: 有一次我转了四十分钟才找到出口。

sentences.en: Have you found any good places to eat?
sentences.zh: 有没有发现什么好吃的地方？
sentences.speaker: Wei

sentences.en: I've tried out every noodle shop in the area.
sentences.zh: 这一片的面馆我全都试过了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: The best one only has six tables, so you have to make it there before seven.
sentences.zh: 最好吃的那家只有六张桌子，得七点前赶到才有位子。

sentences.en: I'm a regular now.
sentences.zh: 我现在是那儿的熟客了。

sentences.en: I'm going to take you there on your first night.
sentences.zh: 你来的头一个晚上我就带你去。

sentences.en: Deal.
sentences.zh: 一言为定。
sentences.speaker: Wei

sentences.en: Anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的吗？

sentences.en: Oh, there's a pub quiz on our street every Thursday.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们这条街上的酒吧每周四有问答比赛。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It's worth going, even though we always come last.
sentences.zh: 很值得去，虽然我们每次都垫底。

sentences.en: And do you like it there?
sentences.zh: 那你喜欢那儿吗？
sentences.speaker: Wei

sentences.en: To be honest, I still don't feel completely at home.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我还没完全找到家的感觉。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I've locked myself out once — well, sort of.
sentences.zh: 我还把自己锁在门外过一次——嗯，算是吧。

sentences.en: Don't ask.
sentences.zh: 别问了。

sentences.en: And I've given up cooking fish.
sentences.zh: 还有，我已经不在家做鱼了。

sentences.en: In a small flat, it just doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 房子这么小，做鱼根本不现实。

sentences.en: The smell stays for ages.
sentences.zh: 那股味儿好久都散不掉。

sentences.en: But I'm starting to love it here.
sentences.zh: 不过我开始爱上这儿了。

sentences.en: Can't wait.
sentences.zh: 等不及了。
sentences.speaker: Wei

sentences.en: Oh, and I've already told my flatmate Tom you're a brilliant cook.
sentences.zh: 哦对了，我已经跟我室友 Tom 说了，你做饭特别拿手。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 啥？
sentences.speaker: Wei

sentences.en: I've never cooked anything in my life!
sentences.zh: 我这辈子连饭都没做过！

sentences.en: Then you've got a month to learn.
sentences.zh: 那你还有一个月可以学。
sentences.speaker: Chen

cards.note: 口语里很常用，意思接近 almost 或「说白了」：It's basically free。重音在第一个音节，ally 读 /li/。
to travel from place to place
cards.tip: 英式也说 get round。get around a problem 是另一个意思：绕开、解决问题。
cards.example: The easiest way to get around the city centre is by bike.

cards.note: 伦敦的地铁叫 the Underground 或 the Tube，美式说 subway；英式里的 subway 是「地下通道」。
from memory, without needing to read it
cost a fortune 是「贵得要命」；fortune 本义是「财富、运气」：tell sb's fortune 算命。
to become unable to find your way
cards.tip: 迷路说 get lost，不说 lost myself。完成时英式说 I've got lost，美式说 I've gotten lost。单说 Get lost! 是「走开」，很不客气。
cards.example: I got lost on my way to the client's office and arrived late.

cards.note: 口语说法，等于 lots of / a lot of：loads of work、loads of friends；比较随意，正式写作不用。
to reach a place by finding the right way to go
cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：find my way / find his way；后面常接 out、home、around 或 to + 地点。
cards.example: It took me a week to find my way around the new office.

cards.note: to use or visit something new to see if you like it
cards.tip: 代词放中间：try it out。try on 是「试穿」，别混。
cards.example: We're trying out a new project tool this month.

cards.note: to succeed in arriving somewhere, especially in time or after a difficult journey
对方提议时回一个 Deal. 就是「就这么说定了」；问对方同不同意可以说 Deal?
英国酒吧常见的活动：大家组队答各种题，赢了有小奖品；quiz 也指课堂上的小测验。
used to say that something is good or useful enough to spend time or money on
cards.tip: worth 后面直接接 -ing：worth going，不说 worth to go；也可以把东西放主语：The quiz is worth going to。
cards.example: It's worth spending a little more on a good office chair.

cards.note: used before you say what you really think, especially something the listener may not like
cards.tip: 放在句首，后面加逗号。写给朋友的邮件里用它显得坦诚，但别每段都用。
cards.example: To be honest, I prefer working from home.

cards.note: to feel comfortable and relaxed in a place
cards.tip: make sb feel at home 让人感到宾至如归；home 前面不加 my：不说 feel at my home。
cards.example: My new team made me feel at home on my first day.

cards.note: to shut a door that locks by accident, with your keys still inside
to stop trying to do something because it is too difficult
cards.tip: give up + doing 是「戒掉、不再做」：give up smoking；过去分词是 given up。
cards.example: I gave up coffee last month, and I'm still tired.

cards.note: to have a clear meaning that is easy to understand
cards.tip: 第 1 课是「看得懂」（The note didn't make sense to me），这里是「合理、划算」：It doesn't make sense to … 做……不合理。
cards.example: It makes sense to test the app on an older phone first.

cards.note: for a very long time
英式口语里常用来夸人或事情「太棒了」，比 good 强得多；也有「聪明的」意思：a brilliant idea。
